products.name: Abstract Thoughts
products.wood: Oak, Walnut, Cherry, Purple Heart, Bloodwood, and Mahogany
products.description: We know rolling can get messy. This custom rolling tray keeps everything organized with two cutouts for your jar or grinder, plus dedicated spots for your lighter, cones, and papers. The chaos pattern helped to bring out our abstract thoughts!

products.name: Froggy Fresh
products.description: Froggy Fresh brings together natural movement and bold character in a one of a kind design. Crafted from Black Limba, the repeating stacked pattern highlights the wood’s unique grain while creating a durable cutting surface built for everyday use. Finished with a built in juice groove, this board is made to stand out in any kitchen.

products.name: The Hollow Eye
products.description: The Hollow Eye blends bold symmetry with the natural contrast of Zebra Wood and walnut. Its repeating stacked pattern creates a striking visual design while providing a durable cutting surface built for everyday use. A functional piece that stands out whether in use or on display.

products.name: The Heirloom
products.description: The Heirloom is a handcrafted valet box made from rich sapele mahogany and finished in shellac. The upper display compartment is perfect for glasses and everyday essentials, while the pull out drawer adds extra storage below. Built with timeless craftsmanship, it’s designed to be both functional and lasting.

products.name: Slippery Walnut
products.description: Crafted with a walnut body and maple slide top, this handcrafted box combines clean design with everyday function. Its smooth sliding lid and timeless wood contrast make it perfect for storing keepsakes, accessories, or daily essentials.

products.name: Zebra
products.description: Crafted from striking zebrawood, this handcrafted charcuterie board highlights the natural contrast and flowing grain unique to the species. Its sleek profile and handle design make it perfect for serving cheeses, meats, and appetizers with a clean, timeless presentation.

products.name: The Ambrosia
products.description: Made from ambrosia maple, this charcuterie board highlights the natural markings and unique character of the wood. Its clean silhouette and timeless design make it perfect for serving cheeses, meats, and appetizers with a warm, rustic feel.

products.name: Blue Roller
products.description: Made from oak with a live edge design and deep blue resin, this rolling tray blends natural character with bold contrast. Designed with dedicated spots for your essentials, it keeps everything organized while bringing a clean, functional centerpiece to your setup.

products.name: Walnut 1
products.description: Cut from solid walnut, this charcuterie board showcases rich dark tones and natural grain variation that make each piece one of a kind. Its sleek profile and balanced shape create a refined serving board that feels equally at home on display or at the center of a gathering.

products.name: Walnut 3
products.description: Featuring striking contrast between dark and warm walnut tones, this charcuterie board highlights the natural depth and movement of the wood grain. Its elongated profile and smooth finish create a refined serving piece designed for both display and entertaining.

products.name: Domestic Bottle Opener
products.description: Built from walnut, maple, and cherry, this bottle opener is made for good drinks and good company. The bold striped design and solid feel give it just the right amount of character, whether it’s opening a cold one at the lake, around the grill, or during a long night with friends.

products.name: Exotic Bottle Opener

The layered hardwood design gives every piece its own vibe, making it the perfect grab for cracking open cold drinks, kicking back, and keeping the good times rolling.

Designed for everyday use and built to last for years to come, it offers the perfect balance of craftsmanship, durability, and timeless style.

Designed for serious prep work and elegant presentation alike, it offers exceptional durability, craftsmanship, and natural beauty in every detail.

Built for everyday use and designed to age beautifully over time, Cherry Ember offers exceptional durability, craftsmanship, and timeless style in a compact size.

products.name: Midnight Cut

Built for everyday use and designed to stand the test of time, Midnight Timber offers exceptional durability, performance, and style in every detail.

products.name: Walnut 2
products.description: This walnut charcuterie board features deep espresso tones and bold grain patterns that give each piece its own character. Designed with a clean tapered profile and smooth finish, it’s a timeless serving board built for both everyday use and special gatherings.

products.name: Cherry Charcuterie
